biggest_catch: No official Amazon Flex payout terms surfaced in search results, and all third-party sources agree there is no same-day cashout — payments are twice-weekly direct deposit.
catches: Third-party sources (ridesharingdriver.com, thebudgetdiet.com) agree: paid Tue + Fri via direct deposit, funds 1-2 days later; no instant pay feature.
Daily-pay workaround (selecting every day as payout day) is market-dependent and reported only by third parties.
No official-domain page confirming payout terms, block pay structure, or timing was locatable.

c1.evidence: Amazon Flex is a real Amazon delivery program, but no official-domain payout terms located.

c2.evidence: Block earnings (reportedly shown before accepting) confirmed only by third parties, not flex.amazon.com.

c4.evidence: Third parties report no instant pay; twice-weekly deposit. Not officially confirmed, and not same-day regardless.

notes: Checked 2026-09-23. Amazon Flex is legitimate and likely verifiable IF official flex.amazon.com pages publish driver payout terms — revisit if found. Even then, timing is days, not same-day.
timing: Not confirmed in official terms; third parties report twice-weekly deposits.
